description: Which English part banks word the lines of the story director's situations (docs/design/story-director.md, part 3). A situation hands the engine a speech act and the facts its records give, filled into the slots below; fits says which bank moves may word that act. A key may name one situation type after an at sign, such as tell@news-arrives, which is tried before the act alone. A line is chosen only when the records fill all its slots, and a part the owner graded down is not chosen. A situation whose lines cannot all be worded is not offered. The banks and these fits are the English engine's lane (P3); the story director only hands over the facts.

slots.name: The given name of the person spoken to, when the records say how the speaker knows them.
slots.about: The given name of the person the situation is about when they are not in the room, such as the one who died.
